item.title: British Ebola patient flown to UK will go to specialist hospital
item.body: A man has been flown back to the UK from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. He will be taken to one of two hospitals equipped to deal with Ebola. Experts have explained the risk to the public.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🏥 British Ebola patient flown to UK will go to specialist hospital

A man has been flown back to the UK from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. He will be taken to one of two hospitals equipped to deal with Ebola. Experts have explained the risk to the public.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 6 November, 18:50
